review_candidates.description: # IT Support & Network Technician Intricate Networks Inc. – Swift Current, Saskatchewan Intricate Networks Inc. is an established technology company based in Swift Current, Saskatchewan. Our IT support team works with a wide range of organizations throughout Swift Current and Southwest Saskatchewan, from small businesses with a handful of computers to larger companies with complex network, server, cloud, and multi-location environments. We are currently looking for an experienced IT Support & Network Technician to join our team. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys solving problems, working directly with clients, and dealing with a wide variety of technologies. No two days are necessarily the same. You may be troubleshooting a workstation in the morning, configuring Microsoft 365 or a network issue remotely, and installing network or server equipment at a client location later that day. The successful applicant will be outgoing, professional, dependable, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot business networks - Support LAN, WAN, VPN, wired and wireless network environments - Install and configure workstations, servers, printers, network equipment, and related hardware - Support Microsoft Windows desktop and server environments - Assist with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration and troubleshooting - Diagnose and repair desktop and laptop computers - Assist with backup, recovery, security, anti-virus, and endpoint protection systems - Help maintain and support client servers and network infrastructure - Assist with new equipment deployments, migrations, upgrades, and other IT projects - Provide computer and software training to clients when required - Document work performed and maintain accurate client and technical information - Participate in occasional after-hours or on-call support Technical Knowledge Applicants should have a solid working knowledge of business computer and network environments, including: - Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint - Google Workspace administration - Microsoft Entra ID / Azure environments - Firewalls, VLANs, managed switches, and business-class wireless networks - Virtualization technologies - Backup and disaster recovery systems - Endpoint security, anti-virus, and cybersecurity best practices - Linux, macOS, and Unix environments - NAS and network storage systems -
